opening.argument: The presentation solicits an upfront payment to join BitClub and then directs viewers toward paid mining opportunities. It states that membership costs $99 and offers mining operations, including a $500 share that pays over 1,000 days. The promised return is presented as substantial and recurring: “fifty percent of all profits will be paid to you on a daily basis.” The offer also extends beyond personal participation, describing payments when a referred person buys a mining-pool share and when that person's coins are reinvested. Those features establish a paid mining and referral-return scheme, although the available evidence does not establish that the mining, profits, or commissions occurred as described.

citations.quote: to join bit club you pay a one-time membership of 99 once your membership is created we have three different mining operations you can engage in
mining pool number one 500 us dollars to purchase one share that pays you for 1,000 days of mining
fifty percent of all profits will be paid to you on a daily basis
Not only will you get paid when someone you refer buys a share of the mining pools but you will also get paid on all the coins they've earned and are reinvesting too
